tools.name: herbarium.find
tools.description: Use this when someone names a plant of West or Central Africa by its scientific name or a common name (for example "Azadirachta indica", "sobolo" or "prekese") and you need to know whether the KwekuAnansi herbarium has a card for it. It returns the matching cards with family and rank, and says plain

tools.name: herbarium.card
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what is recorded about one named plant of West or Central Africa: its names, family, warnings, the uses a collector or a desk note recorded, and how many notes are held back. tools.name: herbarium.about
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what the KwekuAnansi herbarium is, how many plants it holds, where its records come from or what it leaves out. Do not use it to look up a plant: use herbarium.find or herbarium.card.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "herbarium.find" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
